decision: Confirm the existing documented odds ratio calculation for Experiment 1 environmental harm versus help intentionality. The primary title, Joshua Knobe authorship, Analysis 63.3 (July 2003), and pages 190–194 match the reference. The supplied text does not print the DOI, so no independent DOI confirmation is asserted. The First experiment section and p. 192 binary intentionality outcome identify the contrast, distinct from praise/blame ratings or the Second experiment military scenario. The printed 82% intentional in harm and 77% not intentional in help imply the coded 23% intentional complement, reproducing the exact existing odds formula and its three-decimal value 15.251. This verifies the documented calculation from rounded reported percentages, not an odds ratio from unreported cell counts or a chi-square-to-OR alias. Other fields and protected decisions remain unchanged.
